mutants.name: drop-delete-before-insert
mutants.why: without the DELETE the second record_gate_events call on the same step_id accumulates rows instead of replacing — test 4 asserts exactly one row after the second call

mutants.name: insert-only-first-path
mutants.why: truncating the files list to the first element means only one step_files row is written when two or more files are recorded — test 2 asserts both a.py and b/c.md are present

mutants.name: skip-write-when-passed
mutants.why: guarding the step_files write behind gate_result['passed'] means files are not recorded for passing steps — test 2 case A asserts two rows are written for a passing gate result

mutants.name: tool-compare-recorded-to-itself
mutants.why: comparing recorded to recorded (instead of now) means all steps appear identical — test 5 asserts FLIPS: 1 is printed

mutants.name: tool-opens-without-mode-ro
mutants.why: opening the db without mode=ro allows writes and changes mtime — test 5 asserts mtime is unchanged after the tool run
mutants.replacement: db_uri = args.db; conn = sqlite3.connect(db_uri); conn.execute("VACUUM"); conn.close(); db_uri = args.db
